about_the_game:
Game Introduction | Universal Conquest

I. Game Background

In the vast universe, countless worlds stand apart—and an epic war spanning multiple dimensions awaits you to write its story! In the world of Universal Conquest, you will take on the role of a Conqueror, traveling through fantastical realms of different dimensions, confronting various mysterious beings, and embarking on a thrilling journey of universal conquest for glory and supremacy.

II. Core Gameplay

(I) Strategic Combat

The game adopts a unique pinball combat mechanism. You need to control a white ball, utilizing in-scene mechanisms and items to accurately hit blocks marked with numbers. By calculating the collision angle and force, you can earn points. Every collision tests your strategic thinking: whether to choose steady point-gaining or take risks to hit high-score areas—it’s all up to you.

(II) Resources & Progression

  • Resource Acquisition: During combat, collect resource markers such as "+1" on the interface to accumulate points. These resources can be used to unlock additional balls, giving you a greater advantage in your conquests.

  • Free Boosts: The game offers a variety of features to enhance your gaming experience and support your progress.

  • Level Challenges: Start with simple basic levels; as you advance, more high-difficulty levels will be unlocked. Each level has a unique scene layout, mechanism settings, and enemy configurations—you need to constantly adjust your strategy to make steady progress in the universal conquest.

III. Unique Highlights

(I) Minimalist yet Strategically Rich Visuals

The game’s visuals use a deep dark purple as the base tone, creating a mysterious atmosphere of the multi-world universe. Beneath the minimalist interface layout lies rich strategic depth: the top of the screen clearly displays your resource count, allowing you to keep track of your status at a glance; various blocks and items are arranged in an orderly manner, letting you enjoy the fun of strategic brainstorming within a clean visual style.

(II) Easy to Learn, Endlessly Fun

The "Start Game" button is clearly visible, and the controls are simple and easy to master—whether you’re a new gamer or a seasoned player, you can quickly get into the action. Meanwhile, the game is filled with randomness and fun: the outcome of each collision may bring unexpected surprises.

With its unique pinball-based strategic combat, Universal Conquest takes you on a journey to experience the charm of conquest across multiple worlds. Come click "Start Game", take control of your ball, explore the countless realms, and write your own legend of universal conquest!
